claim.claim-text: 1. A method of aligning a coordination system in a therapeutic system; wherein the therapeutic system comprises a laser source that emits a therapeutic laser beam; a laser control system in communication with the laser source, wherein the laser control system controls a parameter of the therapeutic laser beam; and, an analyzer; wherein the analyzer comprises: a memory; executable instructions; and a processor; the method of aligning the coordination system comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the therapeutic laser beam is a femto second laser beam.
4. The method of claims 1, 2 or 3, wherein aligning the coordinate system comprises rotating the coordinate system.
5. The method of claims 1, 2 or3, wherein the aligning of coordinate system corrects for a cyclotorsion of the eye.
6. The method of claims 1, 2 or 3, wherein the pre-treatment image of the eye is of a dilated pupil.
7. The method of claims claims 1, 2 or 3, wherein the treatment image of the eye is of a dilated pupil.
8. The method of claims claims 1, 2 or 3, wherein the analyzer further comprises a light source, and a detector.
9. A method of compensating for a cyclotorsion of an eye; the method comprising:
10. The method of claim 9, wherein aligning a coordinate system comprises rotating the coordinate system.
